title: Schumann — Album für die Jugend, Op. 68 No. 5 (Stückchen)

reference.license: CC BY-SA 2.5 (Mutopia 2007/02/11-653, Philippe Hezaine after Peters). reference.sha256 pins the bare Mutopia .mid at reference.url (fetch copies it into the midi dir; there is no archive).

editionNotes: 4/4, C major, \partial 2. — a dotted-half pickup, so pickupQuarters is 3. The longest anacrusis in the suite and the one most likely to expose a pickup that is measured against a full bar.
printedBars 25 counts the pickup as bar 0 (the MIDI produces bars 0..24). No repeats in the MIDI and no \unfoldRepeats, so performedBars is also 25.
Sibling of schumann-op68-01, which DOES unfold its repeats — the pair is the control that repeatsUnfoldedInMidi is read per piece and not assumed per collection.
No printed metronome mark; the \midi block asks 68 to the quarter. expectedTempo is a band around it.
